title: Inference on Treatment Effects with Repeatedly Mismeasured High-Dimensional Controls
abstract: arXiv:2408.14671v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study inference on a treatment effect in a partially linear model whose high-dimensional controls are observed only through repeated noisy measurements. Replacing the controls by the average of their measurements shifts the double machine learning (DML) moment by a bilinear form in the nuisance coefficients and the measurement-error covariance, a bias that better first stages cannot remove. Within-unit differences among the measurements identify this covariance, which need not be diagonal, without reconstructing the latent controls. Covariance-Recalibrated DML (\CORE{}) subtracts the estimated shift from a cross-fitted score and, because the result is not orthogonal to the covariance, accounts for covariance estimation in its standard error. translated_title: 基于重复误测高维控制变量的处理效应推断
translated_abstract: 我们研究部分线性模型中处理效应的推断问题，该模型中的高维控制变量仅通过重复的含噪测量被观测。用测量值的平均值替代控制变量会使双重机器学习（DML）矩条件产生一个由干扰参数系数与测量误差协方差构成的双线性形式偏移，这种偏差无法通过改进第一阶段学习器来消除。测量值在单元内部的差异可以识别该协方差（其不必为对角矩阵），而无需重构潜在的控制变量。协方差重新校准的双重机器学习方法（CORE）从交叉拟合的得分中减去估计的偏移量，并且由于所得结果与协方差不正交，该方法在其标准误中考虑了协方差估计的不确定性。在近似稀疏性和第一阶段收敛速率条件下（我们针对校正Lasso学习器验证了这些条件），该估计量具有一致渐近线性性质，其置信区间是一致有效的。
tldr: 提出协方差重新校准的双重机器学习方法（CORE），利用重复测量的单元内差异识别测量误差协方差并校正由此引起的矩条件偏移，从而在高维控制变量存在误测的情况下实现处理效应的有效推断。
en_tdlr: Proposes Covariance-Recalibrated DML (CORE), which identifies the measurement-error covariance from within-unit differences of repeated noisy measurements and corrects the resulting moment shift, enabling valid inference on treatment effects with mismeasured high-dimensional controls.
